name: @w6w-apps/tableau
description: Manage Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud sites, projects, workbooks, views and data sources.

w6w.longDescription:
Tableau is Salesforce's analytics and BI platform, reachable through one REST API that fronts two very different deployments: Tableau Cloud (a pod-hosted multi-tenant service, e.g. `10ax.online.tableau.com`) and Tableau Server (a customer's own install, at whatever host they gave it). This app treats the server address the way it treats a self-hosted app's URL — a connection field, not a fixed hostname — because there is no single Tableau host to allowlist.

It covers the surface a workflow actually touches day to day: listing and creating projects, listing, reading and deleting workbooks, reading the views inside them (site-wide or per workbook) and rendering a view to an image, listing and reading published data sources and kicking off an extract refresh without waiting for its schedule, and listing or looking up the users on a site.

Authentication is a Personal Access Token exchanged for a short-lived session — the token is signed in once to get a `X-Tableau-Auth` credential and a site id, and the app refreshes that session by signing in again rather than treating the PAT itself as a bearer credential. Publishing new workbooks, data source extracts and every admin-only surface (users, groups, schedules, permissions) are deliberately out of scope for a first version.
